2. How DMA Detection Works: You are correct that having the cheat/radar run entirely on a secondary PC makes it invisible to software-based anti-cheats on your gaming (Target) PC. This allows the card to safely communicate with the system memory while appearing entirely normal to any anti-cheat checks on your gaming PC.
